identified_defect.description: Three cross-class invokes target private OpticalZoom.fail in v1.7.0 (choose, createSession, State.onConfigureFailed). Previous member-existence verification did not enforce access visibility. Hotfix changes only fail visibility to package-private and contains camera routing exceptions.

implementation.visibility: One private static helper changed to package-private static; no other OpticalZoom method changed.
implementation.error_path: Request/session runtime, linkage, reflective failures become CameraAccessException with original cause; existing CameraAccessException object preserved. Recovery notification RuntimeException/LinkageError cannot block configure-failed callback. Failed/closed sessions clear configured flag.
implementation.preserved: Manual main-wide 1x, AF-ultrawide macro, 3x and 5x selectors and distance auto-switch OFF logic; UI placement; beauty/HEIF/save optimization; original application method payload/assets/native hook; all non-ULike patches.
implementation.unsupported_lenses: No forced nonpublic IDs and no claim of successful pinning when output/session unsupported.
